title: Calculate a sprint dashboard
description: You can trace the report's ratios and projection back to supplied project counts.

steps.description: DATA supplies planned and completed nodes, test counts, sample counts, and known failures for three sprints. TOTAL_NODES sets the full inventory to 18.
The loop calculates completed/planned velocity and passing/total test percentage. It builds text bars from those counts.
Each report prints its supplied samples and failures. completed_so_far adds completed nodes across all three sprints.

steps.question: Do three completed sprints account for all 18 inventory nodes?
steps.answer: No. Their completed counts sum to 15, leaving 3.

steps.description: The projection uses the last sprint's rate and planned node count, displaying about 0.8 more sprints. The final rules are printed text rather than enforcement logic.
